Game changesWiki changes

Selected updates through 13 October 2026.

Updating a world
  • Back up your world before trying an older game version. Newer saves may not open in older versions.
  • Older worlds keep their original terrain. Very old worlds from before the smaller building grid are not converted.
  • Use matching game versions on the server and each player’s computer.
  • Older workshops remain in Worlds with their builds intact. Use blueprints to move a build to a new flat workshop.
  • Blueprints leave out doors. A blueprint using unsupported blocks may not load.

Saves and world files · Moving a build

13 October 2026

  • Added fifteen survival milestones and saved progress.
  • Changed world saves to store more block types and survival milestones.
  • Added placing, opening and removing doors on servers.
  • Added a list of local hosted worlds and visible swings from other players.
  • Fixed hosted saves losing the owner's rest point or reporting success before saving finished.
  • Fixed removing a Journal pin deleting unrelated destinations.
  • Fixed door placement, respawning and undo overlapping open doors.
  • Fixed X to repeat the selected recipe. Mining now chips the struck face and shows growing cracks.
  • Fixed drinking through diagonal obstructions and losing ammunition when a shot cannot launch.
  • Changed held-item motion and made View bob also control walking sway.
  • Fixed world and structure searches, structure updates and sideways item icons.
  • Fixed terrain recovery after a loading failure and long waits while joining an unresponsive server.

12 October 2026

  • Added usable wooden doors and chests, with opening and closing sounds.
  • Changed doors to swing smoothly away from the opener while keeping their full size.
  • Added blueprint capture, movable previews and building from saved structures.
  • Added names, preview pictures and search to the structure library.
  • Fixed saved selections, water restoration on undo and blueprint material costs.
  • Added a flat creative workshop. Older workshops keep their existing builds.
  • Added favourite worlds and pictures of saved worlds.
  • Added a Multiplayer menu for joining servers and hosting a world on the local network.
  • Fixed hosted saving of the owner's inventory, tools, chests and boats.
  • Added Escape to cancel joining and fixed server edits damaging whole doors and chests.
  • Changed the inventory to an item grid and added a feed of gathered materials.
  • Changed the map marker and smoothed map scrolling. Fixed sky showing through distant ground.
  • Added marble building blocks and simpler block names.
  • Changed fish and whale swimming and added gentle cruising for whales, orcas and sharks.
  • Fixed seasons changing survival temperature and walls allowing drinking through them.
  • Added hand and block swings and improved mining, water-entry and impact sounds.

11 October 2026

  • Added blush plaster, rose boards and fuchsia glazed tile.
  • Changed the target card and crosshair, and added adjustable Speed FOV and Damage bob.
  • Changed fox and maned wolf proportions and fixed elephant knees.

10 October 2026

  • Changed 32 common textures to original artwork.

8 October 2026

  • Added source-install scripts for Linux, macOS and Windows.

6 October 2026

  • Fixed respawning at blocked rest points, drinking reach and dynamite floating after losing support.
  • Fixed invalid camera angles and oversized windows.
  • Improved server trust-error messages.
  • Changed snow leopard, seal and maned wolf models and fish swimming.

5 October 2026

  • Added player chat and returning from a server to a local world.
  • Fixed joining, refused building edits and preserving final edits when leaving a server.
  • Fixed water outside save boundaries and missing server-save error messages.
  • Changed several animal models, including horses, elephants, sharks and birds.
  • Fixed animal feet sliding during stops and starts and added breathing and blinks to hoofed animals.

4 October 2026

  • Added saved-world search, held confirmation before deletion and clearer map markers.
  • Added the first multiplayer movement and shared building.
  • Changed local and multiplayer movement for smoother camera motion.
  • Fixed loading invalid world edits and saving when a server stops.
  • Fixed terrain failing to resume loading and improved nearby loading while flying.
  • Added distinct swimming, crawling and walking motions for more animals.
  • Changed several animal models and coats, including foxes, bears, birds and butterflies.

1 October 2026

  • Added inventory workspaces, creative brushes, home storage and expedition records.
  • Added a craftable sailing boat with moving sails, a walkable deck and saved position.

30 September 2026

  • Fixed terrain transitions, ice, cactus joins and excavated structures while exploring.
  • Added a longer, 512-chunk view-distance option.

28 September 2026

  • Added animated Study Grove scenes, weather, music and session cues.
  • Changed loading feedback, trees, ice spires, leaf colours and cloud shadows.
  • Fixed animals standing on steps, horizon seams and lighting on edited structures.

26 September 2026

  • Added biome and landmark finding, ambience, swimming, crawling and third-person views.
  • Changed mountains, islands, biome transitions, lighting and water.

24 September 2026

  • Changed terrain rendering and weather.

23 September 2026

  • Fixed sun glare, night visibility and noisy terrain textures.

18 August 2026

  • Changed building to use half-metre pieces and added more cooking, glass and material recipes.
  • Changed lighting settings and improved leaves, clouds and underwater light.
  • Fixed wave foam and cracks between water surfaces.

17 August 2026

  • Fixed distorted terrain and moving sea surfaces far from the starting area.
  • Added more varied branching shapes to trees.

16 August 2026

  • Added the first sandbox with terrain, trees, gentle survival and an inventory.

About this list

Selected base-game changes from 16 August 2026 to 13 October 2026. Dates follow the recorded history; they are not numbered releases. Early entries sometimes group several changes.
